rows.text: Who knew that the grief and turmoil of the mortal world could not be shaken, even by hiding all the way up here in this filthy place... Yet here we are. I have but one request.
rows.speaker: Germophobic Nymph

rows.text: Could you please give your hands a wash before you offer a greeting using the filthy hand of {RUBY_B#Zagreus} — that two-faced thief{RUBY_E#}!
rows.speaker: Germophobic Nymph
